applied_challenge.panel.match_auto: Auto Match - choose the strongest application
applied_challenge.panel.ownership_note: The student always owns the response. Coaching never fills student fields.
applied_challenge.panel.instructions_pla: Use a local issue, require two alternatives...
applied_challenge.toast.check_needs_draf: Frame a working question and add a draft response before starting a check.
applied_challenge.toast.six_checks: This challenge already has six saved checks. Remove one before adding another.
applied_challenge.toast.no_ai_coaching: AI coaching is not available yet.
applied_challenge.toast.hint_stale: Your work changed while the hint was being prepared. Ask again for an up-to-date hint.
applied_challenge.toast.hint_empty: The coach returned no usable hint. Try again when you are ready.
applied_challenge.toast.hint_failed: The coach could not create a hint. Your work is still saved.
applied_challenge.toast.no_ai_stress: AI stress testing is not available yet.
applied_challenge.toast.stress_stale: Your draft changed while the stress test was being prepared. Ask again for a current challenge.
applied_challenge.toast.stress_empty: The coach returned no usable stress test. Try again when your draft is ready.
applied_challenge.toast.stress_added: One pressure test was added without changing your draft.
applied_challenge.toast.stress_failed: The stress test could not be generated. Your work is still saved.
applied_challenge.toast.no_ai_feedback: AI feedback is not available yet.
applied_challenge.toast.feedback_stale: Your work changed while feedback was being prepared. Request feedback again for the current draft.
applied_challenge.toast.feedback_added: Feedback added without changing your work.
applied_challenge.toast.feedback_failed: Feedback could not be generated. Your work is still saved.
applied_challenge.self_check.heading: Check your deliverable against the brief
applied_challenge.self_check.note: Rate your own draft against each success criterion and constraint. Point to where it is met, or name what is still missing. Honest "not yet" ratings make feedback more useful.
applied_challenge.self_check.where: Where it shows, or what is missing
applied_challenge.self_check.where_place: Quote or point to the part of your draft that shows this.
applied_challenge.cycle.heading: Check {n}
applied_challenge.cycle.earlier_draft: This check began from an earlier draft. That is expected when evidence leads to revision.
applied_challenge.cycle.ai_review: First, decide how to use the AI pressure point
applied_challenge.aria.cycle_choice_reas: Check {n} reason for AI challenge choice
applied_challenge.cycle.why_placeholder: Explain why you will use, adapt, or decline this advice.
applied_challenge.cycle.decline_note: Declining is a valid decision. Explain your reason above; no test plan is required for this cycle.
applied_challenge.cycle.test_question_pl: Write a question that the check could actually inform.
applied_challenge.cycle.threshold: What result could change your mind or draft?
applied_challenge.cycle.threshold_placeh: Name the evidence that would lead you to keep, revise, or replace the current direction.
applied_challenge.cycle.observe_note: Report only what you actually observed or encountered. Summarize feedback without naming participants or including private details.
applied_challenge.cycle.observed: What evidence or observation did you actually encounter?
applied_challenge.cycle.reasoning: Why does the evidence support that decision?
applied_challenge.brief.heading: Challenge brief
applied_challenge.brief.lock_help_verifi: These facts are locked and marked teacher verified. Unlocking and changing them removes verification.
applied_challenge.brief.lock_help_locked: These AI-extracted facts are locked against accidental edits but still need teacher review.
applied_challenge.brief.lock_help_open: Fact editing is enabled. Any change removes verification; relock and verify after checking the lesson.
applied_challenge.supports.heading: Support that fades
applied_challenge.supports.example_note: Different context - not an answer to this challenge.
applied_challenge.workspace.heading: Your problem-solving workspace
applied_challenge.workspace.note: Your writing stays separate from AI examples, hints, and feedback.
applied_challenge.ledger.heading: Evidence & decision ledger
applied_challenge.ledger.note: Optional organizer: connect each important claim or option to support, label its certainty honestly, and keep a tradeoff or uncertainty visible.
applied_challenge.ledger.progress: {complete} of {total} rows have both a claim and support · {verified} verified · {needsCheck} need checking · {assumptions} assumptions
applied_challenge.ledger.facts_pending: Lesson facts are awaiting teacher review, so ledger evidence cannot yet make the overall response "grounded."
applied_challenge.ledger.empty: No ledger rows yet. Add one when a claim, option, or assumption becomes important to your decision.
applied_challenge.aria.ledger_claim: Evidence row {n} claim, option, or position
applied_challenge.ledger.claim_placehold: What are you considering or claiming?
applied_challenge.aria.ledger_evidence: Evidence row {n} evidence or lesson connection
applied_challenge.ledger.evidence_placeh: What supports it, or what would you need to verify?
applied_challenge.aria.ledger_tradeoff: Evidence row {n} tradeoff, constraint, or uncertainty
applied_challenge.ledger.tradeoff_placeh: What might this miss, cost, risk, or leave unresolved?
applied_challenge.stress.heading: Pressure-test the draft
applied_challenge.stress.note: Ask for one targeted challenge focused on {focus}. The AI identifies a pressure point but does not write the revision.
applied_challenge.stress.outdated_note: Your draft changed after this test was created. Save it in a check if you want to preserve how you responded before refreshing it.
applied_challenge.stress.question: Question for your revision
applied_challenge.stress.use_in_check: Use this pressure point in a check
applied_challenge.stress.use_note: You can use, adapt, or decline it, and explain why.
applied_challenge.stress.empty: Add a working question and draft response, then request one challenge when you are ready to test your reasoning.
applied_challenge.validation.heading: Test, observe, decide
applied_challenge.validation.note: Keep an optional trail of checks. Plan what could change your mind, report only what actually happened, then make a student-owned decision.
applied_challenge.validation.empty: No checks saved yet. You can test the draft without AI, or bring the current pressure point into a check.
applied_challenge.validation.footer: Plans, predictions, observations, and decisions stay visibly separate. Refreshing AI support never removes a saved check.
applied_challenge.synthesis.heading: Synthesize what you learned
applied_challenge.synthesis.note: Use the checks above to explain testing, revision, and transfer in your own words.
applied_challenge.feedback.note: Feedback is saved separately and never rewrites the workspace.
applied_challenge.feedback.heading: Feedback for your next revision
applied_challenge.feedback.question: Think about
applied_challenge.teacher_comment.note: Saved with the challenge and shown to the student. It never replaces the student's work.
applied_challenge.teacher_comment.placeh: What is working, and one thing to try next...
applied_challenge.family.investigate.des: Frame a researchable question, identify evidence needs, and plan a responsible investigation.
applied_challenge.family.investigate.tes: Check feasibility, evidence gaps, and ethical limits
applied_challenge.family.investigate.str: a confounding variable, feasibility limit, evidence gap, or ethical concern
applied_challenge.family.design.label: Design
applied_challenge.family.design.descript: Design a solution, model, process, or prototype that applies the lesson under real constraints.
applied_challenge.family.design.testLabe: Test against criteria, constraints, and likely failure points
applied_challenge.family.design.stressTe: an edge case, likely failure condition, overlooked user, or binding constraint
applied_challenge.family.decide.label: Decide
applied_challenge.family.decide.descript: Compare defensible options and make an evidence-based recommendation with tradeoffs.
applied_challenge.family.decide.testLabe: Challenge the recommendation with the strongest alternative
applied_challenge.family.decide.stressTe: the strongest alternative, a neglected tradeoff, or evidence that could change the recommendation
applied_challenge.family.propose.label: Propose
applied_challenge.family.propose.descrip: Build a feasible plan or pitch for an audience while labeling assumptions and resource needs.
applied_challenge.family.propose.testLab: Check feasibility, stakeholders, assumptions, and unintended effects
applied_challenge.family.propose.stressT: a feasibility risk, adoption barrier, resource assumption, or unintended effect
applied_challenge.family.explore.label: Explore
applied_challenge.family.explore.descrip: Examine a contestable question through reasons, perspectives, counterexamples, and implications.
applied_challenge.family.explore.testLab: Consider a counterexample and the strongest alternative view
applied_challenge.family.explore.stressT: a counterexample, internal tension, implication, or strongest alternative view
applied_challenge.agency.progressive.des: AI shows a parallel example, offers a starter, then fades to coaching questions.
applied_challenge.agency.ai-framed.label: AI frames the challenge
applied_challenge.agency.ai-framed.descr: AI writes a complete challenge brief. The student still develops and defends the response.
applied_challenge.agency.co-framed.label: Frame it with me
applied_challenge.agency.co-framed.descr: AI supplies a partial frame and choices while the student shapes the working question.
Coach me while I frame it
AI gives a lesson-grounded direction and prompts but does not write the driving question.
applied_challenge.scope.compact.label: Compact
applied_challenge.scope.compact.descript: A focused application for one lesson or short response.
applied_challenge.scope.standard.label: Standard
applied_challenge.scope.standard.descrip: A complete challenge with evidence, tradeoffs, testing, and revision.
applied_challenge.scope.extended.label: Extended
applied_challenge.scope.extended.descrip: A deeper inquiry or project with explicit assumptions and iteration.
applied_challenge.evidence_status.verifi: Use only when the support connects to a teacher-verified lesson fact.
applied_challenge.evidence_status.needs-: A claim or source connection that still needs confirmation.
applied_challenge.evidence_status.assump: A useful starting point that is explicitly not being presented as a fact.
applied_challenge.self_check_rating.met: Met, and I can point to where
